description: This file defines a generic TypeScript type 'CronJobBase' for representing the base structure of a cron job. It includes properties such as 'id', 'agentId', 'name', 'enabled', timestamps, and various configuration parameters related to scheduling, session targeting, wake modes, payloads, delivery, and failure alerts.

ctags.name: CronJobBase
ctags.pattern: /^export type CronJobBase<TSchedule, TSessionTarget, TWakeMode, TPayload, TDelivery, TFailureAlert/
